verdict.rationale: The only automation-specific evidence is that plugins, written in JavaScript, can be published and updated as new versions via `skpm`, which barely touches versioning. Sketch's version history (starred versions) applies to design documents and Library updates, not to plugins, scripts or MCP-driven automations. Missing for 10: a versioning history for automations, review/approval of automation changes, rollback of automations, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
